dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: Visible 'O' and 'C' shaped structures on the upper dorsal-lateral surface exhibit thin, high-intensity perimeters with irregular, jagged edges. A primary elliptical annulus near the dorsal peak shows a sharp gradient from a light-grey outer ring to a dark-brown interior core.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High density of small, solid light-colored pixel clusters is localized on the posterior dorsal-lateral region. These clusters lack internal gradients and appear as tightly packed, asymmetrical concentrations of high-intensity pixels.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: The centroids of three prominent macro-annuli on the mid-dorsal ridge form an elongated, obtuse-angled triangle, with the longest edge oriented along the longitudinal axis of the body.

other_distinctive_markers: A complex, reticulated web-like pattern is formed on the anterior lateral surface where multiple high-contrast perimeters merge into a continuous network.
